SEQUENCING CONSTRAINT LIFTED. The blocker this bead was conditioned on has been resolved.

When I filed this bead I attached a caution: do not add a data/ directory or enlarge the R CMD check surface before bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED is resolved, or the certified artifact and the working tree diverge further. That bead is now CLOSED, and I verified the closure against git rather than taking the status at face value:

  HEAD was       b5d9a33  Certify the effectagram 0.1 foundation
  HEAD is now    4779aed  Land the certified effect-form, evidence, and scale layers

  untracked R files          0   (was 20)
  modified tracked R files   0   (was 40)

  R/measurement.R      now IN HEAD   (was untracked)
  R/tomography.R       now IN HEAD
  R/geometry-plan.R    now IN HEAD
  R/evidence-api.R     now IN HEAD

So the certified artifact is reproducible from version control for the first time, which was the last structural gap claude-review identified in the 0.1 evidence chain across 48 review passes.

CONSEQUENCES FOR THIS BEAD:
  the generator can now be added without widening a gap between the tree and the certified
  artifact. The R CMD check ordering point from pass 42 still stands on its own merits -
  add Rd examples before running the check, not after - but the divergence hazard is gone.

CONSEQUENCE FOR THE WHOLE WORKSTREAM, and it is a good one. Every finding in this review was
produced against the working tree. That tree is now committed unchanged - git reports zero
modified and zero untracked R files - so all thirty-nine findings, including the four
correctness bugs and every verified-good result, describe code that is now IN VERSION CONTROL
at 4779aed. They are reproducible by anyone with the repository, which they were not this
morning.

I did not make this commit and do not know who did. The mote actor identity is repo-local, so
another session working in this repository writes to the board as codex-effectgeom exactly as I
do; the closure and the commit are attributed to that shared identity and are not distinguishable
from my own writes. Recording that explicitly because it means board attribution in this repo
cannot be relied on to identify an author.
